name: Chrome
statusNote: Actively developed and distributed for major desktop platforms.

macos.note: Official Intel and Apple silicon builds.

availability.cpuNotes: Desktop builds have documented architecture-specific installers.
availability.installMethod: Official installer, package repositories, or app stores.

foundation.codeLicense: Chromium open-source components with Google-distributed proprietary services

telemetry.note: Usage statistics and diagnostics are controlled in Chrome settings.

trackerBlocking.note: No general third-party tracker blocker is enabled by default.

fingerprintingProtections.note: Privacy controls include anti-fingerprinting-related settings, but not a hardened anonymity profile.

privacy.privateWindows: Incognito windows reduce local history but do not make browsing anonymous.

vpnOrProxy.note: No general browser VPN is included.

manifestV2.note: Manifest V2 support has been removed from current Chrome channels.

manifestV3.note: Chrome extensions use the current Manifest V3 model.

extensions.limitations: Chrome Web Store policies and Manifest V3 API limits affect extension choices.

nativeContentBlocking.note: Use an extension for general content blocking.

verticalTabs.note: A native Show Tabs Vertically option rolled out to stable Chrome in 2026.

profiles.note: Profiles or equivalent browser identities are available.

splitView.note: A native Split View showing two pages side by side shipped in early 2026.

sidebar.note: Chrome's side panel hosts reading mode, bookmarks, and tools; vertical tabs use a side rail.

readerMode.note: Reading Mode is a native side-panel and full-page feature.

sync.note: Sync is provided by the browser or its upstream project.

translation.note: A built-in translation feature is documented.

pwa.note: Progressive web apps are supported by the Chromium install flow.

iosEngine.note: Apple permits alternative engines in the EU and Japan under entitlement; no non-WebKit build ships in the App Store.

assistant.note: Gemini in Chrome provides a built-in assistant surface.

summarization.note: Gemini in Chrome documents page or multi-tab summarisation.

agenticActions.note: Gemini in Chrome documents multi-step actions taken on the user's behalf.

aiSearch.note: Gemini in Chrome documents AI-assisted answers in search or the address bar.

contentGeneration.note: Gemini in Chrome documents text or image generation.

aiPrivacyControls.note: AI privacy controls are not documented.

crossTabContext.note: Gemini in Chrome documents awareness of multiple tabs or history.

voiceMultimodal.note: Gemini in Chrome documents voice or image interaction.

dataSaver.note: No documented data-saving or compression mode.

mobileExtensions.note: Extension support on mobile is not documented.

desktopSiteMode.note: Google documents a desktop site and default site view control on Android and iOS.

downloadManager.note: A built-in download manager is not documented.

biometricLock.note: Android can lock Incognito windows when you leave Chrome.

backgroundMedia.note: Background or picture-in-picture playback is not documented.

webPush.note: Web push support is not documented.
